references.text: Prohibition against placing obstacles before the blind or cursing the deaf, showing God's care for people with disabilities
The prophet warns against those who lead the people astray, a similar theme about misleading others
God promises to guide the blind on paths they do not know, in contrast to those who mislead the blind
Jesus refers to the Pharisees as blind guides for the blind, building on the concept of misleading those who cannot see
Jesus calls the scribes and Pharisees blind guides, linking to the theme of misleading others
Paul speaks about those who consider themselves guides for the blind, relevant to the theme of leading or misleading the blind
